study_identification_part.si_3_author_journal_year: Baohong Wen et al., Translational Psychiatry, 2025
study_identification_part.si_4_title: Individualized gray matter morphological abnormalities unveil two neuroanatomical obsessive-compulsive disorder subtypes

nm2_1_modeling_methods.detail: Gaussian process regression (GPR) was employed to estimate the normative range of regional gray matter volumes (GMVs).
nm2_1_modeling_methods.supporting_text: we trained a Gaussian process regression model to estimate the normative range of regional GMVs from age and sex in HCs according to the brain connectome atlas
nm2_1_modeling_methods.location: Wen2025.pdf.md: METHODS / Subtyping analysis based on individualized gray matter morphological abnormalities

nm2_2_response_variable.detail: Regional gray matter volumes (GMVs) obtained from voxel-based morphometry (VBM) using the CAT12 toolbox.
nm2_2_response_variable.supporting_text: Voxel-wise gray matter volume (GMV) for each participant was derived using voxel-based morphometry in the CAT 12 toolbox

nm2_3_explanatory_variables.detail: Age and sex were used as the explanatory variables (predictors) in the Gaussian process regression model to estimate the normative range.
nm2_3_explanatory_variables.supporting_text: we trained a Gaussian process regression model to estimate the normative range of regional GMVs from age and sex in HCs
